تسترحموا (form X)
# تَسْتَرْحِمُوا (tastarḥimū) /tas.tar.ħi.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
# تُسْتَرْحَمُوا (tustarḥamū) /tus.tar.ħa.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَرْحَمَ (istarḥama)
